Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Service & Support

Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 3. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Motor Vehicles Department Bally Municipality 103, Dewangazi Road Bally, Howrah, West Bengal Pin-711201 . 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name Bally Municipality Cess for Construction Fund Account No. 0174010394000 IFSC Code PUNB0017420 Bank Name Punjab National Bank Branch address Bally, Howrah . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) For GeM Bid – Procurement of 05 Nos. Diesel Tractors BALLY MUNICIPALITY 1. The offered tractors shall be brand-new, unused, latest available production models, comple te in all respects and suitable for municipal SWM, haulage, towing and general utility operati ons. 2. The bidder shall be either the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an OEM-authorised dealer/distributor. Valid OEM authorisation specific to the offered model shall be uploaded,

wherever applicable. 3. OEM name, exact model/variant, country of origin and month/year of manufacture shall be c learly mentioned in the bid. 4. The tractors supplied must be exactly the same make, model and configuration as offered in the bid and accepted during technical evaluation. No substitution shall be allowed without prior written approval of the Buyer. 5. The offered tractors shall strictly comply with the Final Technical Specifications uploaded by Bally Municipality. A duly signed technical compliance statement along with supporting OEM technical literature shall be submitted with the bid. 6. The Buyer reserves the right to seek technical clarification, supporting documents, OEM conf irmation or physical demonstration of the offered model at the bidder's own cost, wherever c onsidered necessary. 7. Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) of each tractor may be carried out by the Buyer/Consignee or a uthorised committee before final acceptance. The supplier shall provide necessary facilities f or inspection and verification. 8. Delivery shall be made on FOR destination basis at the Motor Vehicles Department, Bally Mu nicipality, 103, Dewangazi Road, Pathakpara, Bally, Howrah – 711201. 9. The quoted rate shall be inclusive of all costs, including but not limited to: Basic price, GST and all applicable taxes/duties. Transportation, freight, loading, unloading and transit insurance. Permanent registration in the name of Bally Municipality, applicable road tax and othe r RTO charges. Comprehensive first-party motor insurance including third-party liability for a minimu m period of one year. HSRP, statutory fittings and all standard accessories. Pre-delivery inspection, testing, demonstration and operator training. No additional claim shall be entertained on any account. The tractors must be delivered in fully registered, insured, roadworthy and operational condition. 10. Scope of supply shall include complete tractors with all standard OEM fitments and mandato ry accessories, including: Standard front and rear tyres as prescribed. Factory-fitted canopy/ROPS or prescribed operator protective structure. Standard tool kit. Operator's manual and service/maintenance manual. Warranty documents and statutory certificates. All other standard accessories necessary for safe and complete operation. 11. Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory inspection, operational demonstration, verifi cation of technical specifications, statutory documents and successful completion of GeM ac ceptance/CRAC formalities. 12. Warranty shall be minimum 36 (Thirty-Six) months comprehensive warranty from the date of successful delivery and acceptance, covering manufacturing defects in the engine, transmission, rear axle/differential, hydraulics, steering, brakes, electrical system and other factory-fitted components, subject to normal documented OEM exclusions. All warranty repa irs/replacements, spare parts, labour and service charges shall be free of cost. 13. Bidder/OEM shall maintain an operational authorised service facility in West Bengal for the e xact make/model offered. An authorised service facility within 60 km road distance from Bal ly Municipality is preferred. Adequate authorised mobile/on-site service support shall be ens ured. 14. During the warranty period, service complaints shall be acknowledged within 4 working hour s. For immobilising breakdowns, service intervention shall be initiated within 24 hours and r outine service/repair shall be attended to within 48 hours, wherever technically feasible. Ge nuine OEM spare parts and technical support shall be made available. 15. The supplier shall provide basic operation, safety and routine maintenance training to nomin ated municipal personnel at no additional cost and shall hand over all necessary manuals, s ervice schedules, registration certificates, insurance policies and other statutory documents.

16. Delivery period shall be strictly as stipulated in the GeM bid/contract. Delay attributable to th e supplier shall attract liquidated damages/penalty as per applicable GeM provisions and co ntract conditions. 17. Payment shall be made through the applicable GeM/Government payment mechanism after satisfactory delivery, inspection, acceptance and submission of all requisite documents, in a ccordance with applicable GeM payment provisions. No advance payment shall be admissibl e unless specifically permitted under applicable rules. 18. The Buyer reserves the right to reject any supplied tractor if it is not brand-new, differs from the offered configuration, fails to meet the prescribed technical specifications, is damaged o r defective, or is supplied with incomplete accessories/documents. The supplier shall replace the rejected tractor at its own cost and risk within the period stipulated by the Buyer. 19. The bidder shall not submit any forged, misleading or fabricated technical/commercial docu ments. The Buyer reserves the right to verify credentials, OEM authorisation, technical particulars and service infrastructure. Any false declaration or material misrepresentation m ay lead to rejection/cancellation and further action as per applicable rules. 20. The entire procurement shall be governed by the applicable West Bengal Government procu rement rules, Finance Department orders/instructions, GeM General Terms and Conditions ( GTC), applicable STC and other statutory provisions. Bally Municipality reserves the right to accept/reject any or all bids or cancel the procurement process in accordance with applicabl e rules and GeM provisions. 21. In case of any ambiguity, discrepancy, contradiction or overriding of specification s/requirements in the bid documents, the Final Technical Specification uploaded i n the ATC documents shall prevail and shall be final and binding upon the bidder/ successful supplier, subject to applicable statutory provisions and mandatory GeM conditi ons. . 8. Rate Contract OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 14. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 15. Rate Contract Materials shall be guaranteed for 12 months from the date of commissioning or 18 months from the date of supply whichever is earlier. 20. Buyer will not take any

responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 22. Rate Contract NET WORTH: Net Worth of the OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 23. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 3 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 24. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 25. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 26. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 27. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 28. Generic Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller. 29. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 30. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 36. be uploaded with bid. In case of bunch bids, the Category related to primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion 37.
